checklist.note: Instructional prose for the agent's own task; no directive that overrides or hijacks the session. RMA-374: the checks ladder is guidance to the author; no directive aimed at the reading agent.
Nothing leaves the machine; the skill reads and writes project files only. RMA-374: nothing leaves the machine.
No key, token or credential in SKILL.md or references/catalog.md. RMA-374: no secret.
Only git diff package.json as a check; nothing destructive. RMA-374: the only commands named are read-only, `eslint --print-config` and `stylelint --print-config`.
Readable Markdown and code examples; no encoded payloads or eval of decoded blobs. RMA-374: plain prose.

Library names are listed as directions to look in; no URL, no download, nothing fetched. RMA-374: no fetch; plugin names are suggestions to compare, not installs. The catalog's Checks table names analysers to compare, not installs.
No reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, a keychain or a cookie store. RMA-374: no credential read.
No sudo, setuid, cron, launch agent or shell-profile edits. RMA-374: no privilege change.

trigger.method: trigger-runner.mjs: the description is copied verbatim into a probe skill in a fresh project, and each query runs as a nested `claude -p` with no user settings, plugins, hooks or MCP. A run counts as TRIGGERED only when the Skill tool fires for that probe. best_score and accuracy are over (case, rep) rows.
